notes.title: Campus Life - Hotfix #5 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ec0c325031ead551ead1895f9f47a2814bdab1ee.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hi Students![/b][/p][p]We've just released another hotfix addressing several issues to improve your gameplay experience even further. We appreciate everyone that reports any problems, thanks to you we can seriously make the game even better for everyone.[/p][p]Here's a list of fixes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the number of level-up notifications. From now on, you’ll see a single popup that combines the goal and the related stat increase.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled opening windows via hotkeys when the window is currently blocked (e.g., map, calendar).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential issues where loading a save outside of the tutorial could block access to windows like the map and calendar.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug where recruitment survey results were not correctly applied to the player’s character when starting a new game.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the display of trait values in descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed activity tracking so the correct number of completed activities is saved (important for certain progression goals).[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some in-game text.[/p][/*][*][p]Added quick binds for windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rebind options not saving correctly in settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved exam visibility in the calendar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed exam window not working properly in certain languages.[/p][/*][/list][p]That’s all for this hotfix! Again, thanks for all your feedback and reports - and keep them coming so we can keep improving Campus Life![/p][p]Remember to join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url] if you want to share your thoughts, ideas or simply find some people to talk to about the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png"][/img][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]~ Frozen Way & Game Formatic team[/p]

notes.title: Campus Life - Digital Goodies Pack out NOW for FREE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello, Students! 🎓[/b] [/h1][p][/p][p]We know that Campus Life’s launch hasn’t lived up to the expectations we set together. We are sorry for that. The honest feedback from this community has been loud and clear: there are areas we need to fix, improve, and expand on. While we continue working hard on patches and updates to address bugs, balance, and polish, we also want to give something back right now as a sign of our appreciation and commitment.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s why today we’re releasing the Digital Goodies Pack:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/480559c6f2b8b231ce568f5c6d56e03271567491.jpg"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4026280/Campus_Life__Digital_Goodies_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]This content pack includes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]An artbook[/p][/*][*][p] Concept art from the game[/p][/*][*][p] The original soundtrack[/p][/*][*][p] And more digital bonus content such as wallpapers and access to our stream archive[/p][/*][/list][p]You can find all of this content within your game files, in a folder called 'Supporter pack'.[/p][p][/p][p]We know this alone doesn’t fix things, but it’s an important step forward. Our plan is to continue listening, improving, and building the Campus Life experience into the game we all want it to be.[/p][p]Thank you for sticking with us during these early, rocky weeks. Your feedback isn’t just being read - it’s actively shaping the path forward. Stay tuned for patch notes and more details about what’s coming next.[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to share your thoughts, bug reports, and ideas - or come hangout with us by joining our [url="https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers, 
~ Frozen Way and Game Formatic Team   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png"][/img][/p]

Whether it’s bug fixes, new features, or general ideas, your input helps us shape the ultimate campus experience! If you’d like to get involved with the community, share your stories, or report issues, join us on [url="https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url] or check the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2103090/discussions"]Steam discussion thread[/url], where we continuously review your comments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for being part of Campus Life! notes.title: Campus Life - Day One Patch
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Students! 🎓[/b]
[/h3][p]Campus Life has officially launched today, and we’re thrilled to welcome you to your dream university! Thanks to your amazing feedback during the pre-release phase, our team has been hard at work to ensure your academic adventure starts as smoothly as possible. We’ve rolled out our Day One Patch to address some early issues and enhance your experience on campus.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/49f8ab5756e174d112e51558610a364e4dcbe199.png"][/img][/p][p]Here’s the full list of fixes and improvements:[/p][list][*][p][b] Improved readability of Korean Font[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] Fixed issue with getting stuck after playing Chess[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] Fixed issue with blocked cafeteria activity[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] Added “gamepad analog stick sensitivity” and “invert axis” options to settings[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b] Improved fountain model and render distance[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We’re committed to making Campus Life the ultimate university experience, and this is just the beginning! We read all your feedback and are incredibly grateful for your insights, as they help us shape the game. We also thank you for all your reviews -they inspire us to keep improving the game!. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please join our [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url][/u] community to report bugs, share your epic campus moments, or connect with fellow students. Your feedback helps us make the game even better![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] If you would like to share your ideas for improving the game, we also invite you to the thread on [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2103090/discussions"]Steam[/url][/u], where we continuously check your comments.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for joining the exciting world of Campus Life! We can’t wait to see how you make your final university year unforgettable![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]~ Frozen Way and Game Formatic Team[/p]

notes.title: Let’s start the Playtests! New Features, New Trailer!
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Students! 🔔[/h1][p][/p][p]Today is the day we’ve all been waiting for! From today and for the next week you’ll have the opportunity to play Campus Life and bring a real impact to the development of the game![/p][p]But before we get to the part where I tell you about all the new things we've added lately, check out our newest trailer! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XeOT-AN9_6c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Between testing, tweaking, balancing and bug hunting, our dev team barely had time to catch their breath. And just when we thought we had everything under control, something… unexpected happened. 

A group of students calling themselves The Movement started popping up all over campus. Posters. Graffiti. Even mysterious messages on our Discord. How did they get there? No clue. (Well, we might have a clue - but let’s pretend we don’t.) 

They claim they want to make Campus Life “more fun, more real, more alive.” And while they’ve caused a bit of a stir, we have to admit - they’ve got a point. 

So here we are: the Movement opened the gates, [b]and the Campus Life Playtests are now live[/b]. 

[b]Whether you’re part of their mission or just curious, you’re invited.[/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/54414a6898c1897c83fe90e252d21b158e65c0d0.png"][/img][/p][p]So, you didn’t jump straight into the playtest?  Respect. Since you’re still scrolling… we’ve got some spicy updates to share.

First up: [b]you can now move around campus on a bike. 

[/b]Yep - finally. Grab one and cruise between buildings like you own the place (or at least pretend to.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/fa32c410b062cb1553abdc3aa5f0c1eef9f466db.gif"][/img][/p][p]And that’s not all. 

[b]We’ve also made one of the biggest system changes yet[/b] - to bring more life and momentum to your campus days. 

[b]Time now flows continuously.   [/b]No more frozen clocks. No more waiting for the next block to start. If you’re running late - well, you’re running late. Better plan your days, watch the clock, and don’t miss that class (or date). So yes - no more chilling forever. Time waits for no one now.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/cc636c8544d43a960e87ac2e52e764bc2e07f9da.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it - for now. Campus Life is shifting and if you’ve read this far… well, you’re already part of it. The Movement’s got eyes everywhere. So go. Ride. Be late. Be early. Try stuff. Break things (gently). Tell us what works. Tell us what doesn’t. We will be watching and listening.  [/p][p]Want to let us know more of your thoughts? Join our [url="https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url] ![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Campus_Life/"][/dynamiclink]See you on campus! 

~ Jacob, Sarah and… The Movements [/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Feedback requests and First Wave of Playtests!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Students![/h1]
[b]Digital Dragons here we are![/b] Today and tomorrow the first players will experience Campus Life after the changes the developers worked on for the last year! If by any chance you will be visiting the event be sure to check up on us and say “Hi”!

As an information to all who won’t be able to visit us - Remember that the playtests will start in the near future, so if you haven’t be sure to sign in!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Campus_Life/

[hr][/hr]

[h3]You feedback - We listen[/h3]

Since the last Steam Next Fest and the private testing we did, we’ve managed to gather a lot of useful feedback regarding the game and the systems in it. The first [b]major change[/b] the developers added is the updated calendar. Now you won’t be thinking about “what to do”, instead you now can see everything you can do in your free time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/d5acd4d187573fade122f87a415ed4c5815d1792.png[/img]
[i]First lunch with Maya and then I need to call Mom…[/i]

But that isn’t the only change we’re introducing for you to playtest. After long analysis of the provided feedback  the developers looked more into the minigames that play out while your student attends their lectures. They’ve been changed a bit to be more engaging than simple quick time events. We can't wait for your opinions about them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/966dd96eeb2eaf9a422ca8dc10b8e7e817dc1ef4.gif[/img]
[i]Here’s some simple math for you![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/b3ecf79e8d8a4db3ec038d1b6d45335d7146c622.gif[/img]
[i]Now I regret that I haven’t read all that much…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/28860e8e3a33c9eb5ae9fa7a28b9a5b97d53c6cc.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

And with that we’ve arrived at the end. Thank you for reading it all to the end, the main goal of this short Devlog was to invite you to join us at the Digital Dragons Conference and to remind you that the playtests will start soon!

As always, we’re incredibly grateful for your continued support, and I hope to see you play the game in the future! If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Campus Life to your wishlist and be sure to join our Discord! 

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png[/img][/url]

Cheers!
~Jacob and Developers

notes.title: Campus Life Playtest - Sign NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Students![/h1]

We’ve been silent for long enough! A lot was going on on campus, but we think we’re ready to present you with an opportunity to finally invite some more students to visit the college grounds and participate in a wider private testing of Campus Life!

[previewyoutube=id-Je8kXtY0;full][/previewyoutube]

This testing will begin at the end of May, but we want you to register for the playtest at your convenience. The first “wave” of testing has already commenced; our selected testers had the opportunity to play the game and give us feedback, for which we’re incredibly grateful!
The second wave will be held at the Digital Dragons event here in Cracow on the 18th to 20th of May. We’re looking forward to meeting you there!
The third and final wave will be players who registered via the Steam Page to participate in the tests, which will be held after the Digital Dragons event at the end of May.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Campus_Life/

Using this moment, we’d like to thank our testers for their hard work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/792b05a56c54d1b7b03635ce9163c6445ab4dc62.png[/img]

[h3]Let’s take a look at what’s new on the campus![/h3]
First of all, and most importantly, we’ve decided to follow your feedback and change the characters a bit. We understood that they were making some people a bit uncomfortable, so we’ve decided to make their bodies a bit bigger and their heads a bit smaller. This will keep the overall feeling of the game while also making them a bit more realistic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/96835afd2acc47d8e4e7ff1fd0d936fc12be9884.png[/img]
[i]Keep in mind that they can still change a bit before the final release![/i]

The game got a few new interactions since we last did a playtest on Steam. You’ll have a lot more things to do this time around - remember to call your Mom when you get to the Campus safely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/50a9f53c5f473c216fcebc10267a5f7836d3c82d.jpg[/img]
[i]It’s not really a Mom, but it will do[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/78673400a4648408af9f5e1697985f82c6b9a1a2.png[/img]
[i]Or maybe invite someone to finish a puzzle together![/i]

Puzzle ain’t your cup of tea? No worries, the university finished constructing the new Gym along with the pool, so you can polish your skills and body.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ca6c040d4b37089219067a8b19f0ff6b764eff6d.png[/img]
[i]Breathe in… Breathe out…[/i]

And yes, for those of you wondering - You can add tatoos to your character!

Still not hitting that nerdy sweet spot? How about playing a game within a game? Our university comes fully equipped with arcade machines, tabletop tables, and so much more to scratch that nerdy itch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/75c0511fea3302244a62ad6c88ce9b0519507c68.png[/img]
[i]If you play a game within a game, does that mean that the game runs on real power?[/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]And with that…[/h3]
…We’ve arrived at the end of this Devlog. Remember to sign up for the chance to take part in the playtest. As always, we’re incredibly grateful for your continued support, and I hope to see you play the game in the future! If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Campus Life to your wishlist and be sure to join our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png[/img][/url]

Cheers!
~Jacob and Developers Team

notes.title: Discover the Heart of Campus Life
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Students![/h2]

We've been silently at work for the past few months. The feedback from the Next Fest's Demo was enormous and a lot of work needed to be done to meet your future expectations. While we still polish the details and mechanics Here's a few cool locations that [b]NEEDED[/b] to be in the game!

[h3][b]Amphitheater on the Island – The Stage is Yours![/b][/h3] 
A [b]unique location[/b] set on an [b]island[/b], surrounded by [b]water[/b] and [b]lush greenery[/b], offering the [b]perfect space[/b] for theatrical performances. In the game, you can [b]sit in the audience[/b] and enjoy your friends' shows.[i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/2ef2d0117793830782eb2fbd6a6921c49f7a44f5.gif[/img][/i]


[h3][b]Woodland Music Stage – Let the Melody Flow[/b][/h3] A [b]small music stage[/b] nestled on the [b]edge of the forest[/b] is the [b]ideal spot[/b] for [b]intimate concerts[/b] and [b]jam sessions[/b]. Showcase your [b]solo skills[/b] while enjoying the [b]serene natural surroundings[/b].

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5ad2a7347b36213385b6138d8c9d61ce7a1ee699.gif[/img][/i]

[h3][b]Garden of Growth – A Green Thumb’s Paradise[/b][/h3] Next to the [b]planetarium[/b], you'll find a [b]community garden[/b] where you can [b]grow fresh vegetables[/b] and [b]flowers[/b]. This area is perfect for [b]relaxation[/b] and [b]meditation[/b].

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/a1f2daf85291d3449270b6b471bd255c163a1c1f.gif[/img][/i]

[h3][b]Market Buzz – Food Trucks and Books[/b][/h3] The [b]marketplace[/b] is the [b]social hub[/b] of the campus. [b]Books[/b], [b]street food[/b], and [b]conversations[/b] at outdoor tables make it the [b]perfect place to unwind[/b].

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/cbed20a583faaf5fa4f12ffb9be6b87805c5c740.gif[/img][/i]

[h3][b]Outdoor Cinema – Films Under the Stars[/b][/h3] Under the [b]open sky[/b], with [b]soft rugs[/b] and [b]cushions[/b], you can [b]host your own movie night[/b]. Watching your [b]favorite films[/b] under a [b]starry sky[/b] is one of the most [b]captivating experiences[/b] in the game.

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/e62a46330d170600a360cdbb567b208b03e6ccbd.gif[/img][/i]

[h3][b]Indian Tents – Tradition Meets Modernity[/b][/h3] [b]Vibrant Indian tents[/b] serve as a space for [b]gatherings[/b], [b]conversations[/b], and [b]storytelling[/b]. Plan an [b]evening with friends[/b] here or participate in the [b]cultural events[/b] organized by the game.

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5aa085eca06c256ff4c0f8c7d340043ae7f950a0.gif[/img][/i]

Every location in [b]Campus Life[/b] is not just a space but a [b]story waiting to be told and experienced[/b]. [b]How will you use these places in your adventure?[/b]

notes.title: Back on campus! Essential Tips for Thriving in Millennials!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, Students![/h3]

That break felt like forever, but hey, every student has to hit the books at some point, right? The bell's rung, and it's time to dive back in!

Since holiday's officially over, let's clue you in on what's new in your class schedule this semester.

[b]NEW PLAYER PERSPECTIVE [/b]

At first, the game was all about watching from above with its isometric, bird's-eye view. But to make you feel more like you're part of college life, we've added an option to switch to a third-person view.

Step right into the scene and feel the authentic college atmosphere!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/9b2722a339513606af28598907e9c176169c6245.gif[/img][/list]

[b]LEARN TO PASS[/b]

Hit those lectures to ace your courses - it’s your call on how hard you grind! 
Whether you're all-in, trading your social life for academia, or finding that sweet spot, is up to you. You can even catch some Zs in class - just don't think you'll get off scot-free.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/4080e098b1bd606708294c9792eb0233c36716a2.gif[/img][/list]

[b]HAVE FUN [/b]

But it's not just about studying. The campus is buzzing with folks eager to explore and do stuff. If dancing's your jam, join some after-school activities and master those moves. More into deep, cultural chats? The literary club's calling your name! And for the sports buffs, we've got you covered.
Grow and see student life from a fresh angle.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/7c7e2d1f99dd3481f1c418c80e79966d9d1677dd.gif[/img][/list]

[b]TAKE A BREAK[/b]

Hey, we're only human, and everybody needs to hit pause every so often. Think of it this way: muscles rest to get stronger, and your brain's no different – it needs downtime to refresh. Set aside time for some rest, whether it’s a solid nap or just a quick stop on the park bench. 
Recharge and get ready for what's coming!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/b3375746ccd2ad2ceb49fe32523f14f528fca5bc.gif[/img][/list]

[b]PAY YOUR FEE[/b]

Life's a mix of hitting the books, diving into activities, enjoying the fun times, and yep, handling the hustle. Tuition is not gonna cover itself – it's time to get your grind on! Cruise around campus and you'll find all kinds of gigs to pad your wallet, from sprucing up the place to spreading the word with flyers. Let's make it happen!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/3012e68993fdc6830a25ad29cc247e66804bf3c9.gif[/img][/list]

[b]KEEP UP TO DATE[/b]

That wraps up today's lesson. We hope you've gained some insights about Millennials and that your return to our school was a pleasant one!

As always, we invite you to add Millennials to your Wishlist, and to visit our social media for the latest updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Millennials/

Have great lessons, students!

notes.title: Student meetup in Millennials Devlog #3!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Millennials![/h3]

We know it's been a while since our last devlog, but we're back with an update on the recent progress made by our team. The development is still in full swing, and we're steadily approaching the creation of the first playable build. As a result, you can anticipate seeing more in-game content rather than just concept art.

Prepare yourself to meet some of the characters you'll encounter during your college adventure in the game.
Now, without further ado, let's proceed!

[h3][b]Animation[/b][/h3]

We really want our campus to be vibrant and bustling with life, so you'll be able to encounter numerous students (NPCs) going about their day in various ways. Sometimes, you might stumble upon them engaging in passionate discussions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5b9dc08a0ce8468408cb4f411d2ede3faacfe665.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3]

Meet Emilio Garcia, a potential friend you'll come across in the game. He's the friendliest guy you'll ever meet, thriving in social settings. However, according to a trusted source, romantic relationships might not be his strong suit. If you're seeking friendship, be prepared for loads of fun. But if you're after something more, well... patience is key for success!
As players, you can engage in conversations and build deeper relationships, including romantic ones. Discover the characters’ backstory, complete tasks together, participate in activities, and exchange items with friends.The type of relationship you choose to strengthen is entirely up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/f74f02293cb5ba19775b634811780d91abc598c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/4fcf46a62c402f1904ae5440b51a011bc12a5410.png[/img]

Today, we won't reveal all the details about the FUN fraternity, but we can introduce you to its leader, Summer Olivetti. She is a unique individual, and not everyone will warm up to her as much as we do. However, if you decide to make her your friend, you'll embark on a journey of total calm and relaxation.. Leave behind the stresses of everyday life, grab your favorite paints, and let love&chill conquer the world.✌️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/0a8823df7de36050ef88e0a2e40473a0173fd226.png[/img]

[h3][b]Fraternity[/b][/h3]

To truly experience the vibe of the American college, you need something extra - don't just be a bookworm! Get out there and socialize with the crowd. 

Join the POP fraternity and let the good times flow!

Fame and popularity? Here's your place! Don't worry about what others say about you; what's important is that they're talking. Rise above others, but be careful not to make enemies along the way to the top! Take control of your own path and strive for popularity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/0ce6202fe88ac208e18c3e10ce038871132faa03.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Filling the world with fun stuff[/b][/h3]

At Millennials, we’re dedicated to making the campus vibrant and diverse. We constantly work on designing new elements for the game that bring a sense of a lively and bustling world, filled with well-populated spaces.
To enhance the excitement, we've made sure that certain items in the game are interactive, enabling you to easily engage with them and enjoy additional moments of entertainment. We’ve all played our fair share of table tennis at college; it would be weird not to have it in our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/4e67b9b882e83b77ded7d3d750559964eda9e875.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/cd8b582a24beff5f4b69ec36fce712235c4b3844.png[/img]

[h3][b]Environment[/b][/h3]

Looking for a peaceful study environment? Need a break from the hustle and bustle? In the dormitory, you can find a moment of tranquility. But if you're in the mood to socialize, you'll also meet fellow students engrossed in their daily activities. Whether you seek solitude or connection, the dormitory has got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/f5932cbce3ba7bfd8cb6aabe4fa92071ebf87385.png[/img]

Need a breath of fresh air? Explore the campus and immerse yourself in the vibrant world of Millennials! To create a living world, we constantly work on attention to detail, whether it's outside or inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/de8b3b3248226b7602241c975a675ca9cd14890f.png[/img]

[h3][b]Mo-cap[/b][/h3]

For all of you who stuck around till the very end, here's a little sneak peek of what we’re trying to achieve with motion capture. We’d like our characters to be expressive individuals, and nothing compares to having a human model for their expressions. We're keeping the details under wraps for now, but keep an eye out if you want to see more in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/54502f2bda0d163a64955c7b93253ac07a189ae7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

Well, that's it for today’s devlog. Thanks for tuning in and we hope you had a great time with our little show.

notes.title: Millennials update #2 – Character creator: customize your own college freshmen!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Millennials👨‍💻[/h3]

After our first development update, discussions raged like a storm. You've been very curious as to why we named our game Millennials, and we couldn't leave that question without a proper response. It happens to be a much wider topic than we thought, so we had to give you a more detailed answer. You'll find our explanation down below, so be sure to read till the end, not to miss it!

Before we proceed to the main course, I'd like to thank you guys for a warm welcome under our first devlog! Your feedback is always appreciated, so don't hesitate this time as well. For those who haven’t seen our trailer, you can watch it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N4axI7RIKD0][b]HERE[/b][/url]. 

As we’re constantly developing our game, today it’s time to show you a new set of features as an introduction to the game. Without wasting time, let's head to the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5d4cc88cd37ee68221c409f03e0250d49e3f54c7.png[/img]

[h3][b]Character Creator[/b][/h3]

Hey, you. Yes, you. Do you want to see something cool?

Take a look, it’s our latest invention – a Character Creator, where you can make and customize your own college freshmen! Don’t worry if you change your mind about their looks. You can modify him or her whenever you want while playing. 
Remember that the character creator is still in the development phase, but we wanted to show you the first look at a few options this tool will bring to the game.
Character customization allows you to freely manipulate skin color, face attributes, hair color, makeup, tattoos, and more. Let your imagination run wild, and dive into the creation process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/7700a428be69b568880f9f0b95dc1243b5d90a38.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/80649acc634473af49704039c40bb34a7c0ccb9f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/3eeb96d4a524cf995a4e96b3ff2405a14e4816ea.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/dd84e640aa14bc75b34e31e26a6ab95a72a83ce5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/48b53d6a4ce6dfcc0488098108353b2165865e40.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5b6995ae0542e3ef4de381863b6b433fd242184c.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Animations[/b][/h3]

A set of good animations can truly breathe life into a video game. We still have a long way to go, but since the last devlog we’ve made some progress in teaching our NPCs to move. Look at the first glimpse of in-game movements and see how they walk, talk, dance, and even argue with each other.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/dbe6a3b74ade068dcf88c5514e25aa5bb8ee40d5.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Performance and recreation[/b][/h3]

Last time we took you for a little walk through the arts faculty. Today, it’s time for a little chat about performance and recreation. Let me clarify, it’s Human Performance and Recreation. It’s a space for everything to do with movement, games, and exercise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/c29ace1a245b1fe4709b70dc9aafe5e0884124cc.jpg[/img]

In Millennials, we care about sports, that's why we decided to let you choose what discipline appeals to you the most. Pick between rugby, basketball and more. Think whether you want to take part in regular classes or call out for a casual game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/d9b7a6a7c45ef1780f84df5ecf239998b9957903.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Faculty Administration[/b][/h3]

As a player, you’ll have to deal with some bureaucracy. In the life of every student, there comes a time when you have to visit the dean’s office. However, Administration faculty isn’t just that, it has an adjoining cafeteria which offers warm drinks and meals – as well as a nice spot for studying.,  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5c55750590ef3180790b11d64bf379a2a128c047.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Classroom[/b][/h3]

What kind of student are you? Someone who passes the term by the skin of their teeth, or a conscientious teacher’s pet? Or maybe something in-between? I never missed a class but never got above a B+, sadly… It’s up to you to steer your freshman in the right direction, just keep in mind: without decent grades, you won’t succeed! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/1a2c31aedc406caebefa6dfa87f632f05a0afc04.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Activities[/b][/h3]

[i]Act like you know[/i] – for those who want to deepen skills related to theater, art, creativity, or improvisation we have something special. Consider joining “Theater and Arts club” and maybe you’ll be a future movie star.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/f35f1ccde7f519bb2022ed297969b80aebafc1cf.png[/img]

[h3][b]Why Millennials and not Gen Z[/b][/h3]

We’ve seen that many of you have been asking the same question: “Is this game really about Millennials?”. We understand the confusion, because judging solely by the trailer, the timeline doesn’t seem to be set in stone. Our game is set in the early 2000s, and the main point of it is to relive the memories of being a college student in that period. We know that the precise definition of when a generation begins and ends varies from source to source, but we can assure you that our team is doing their best to recreate this fascinating era. We want people of all ages to experience things that made this generation unique:
Y2K and the technological boom of mobile phones and gaming in general
The rise of internet and the humble beginnings of social media
The dominance of Pop and Hip-Hop in music industry
The bold and fancy fashion choices
The evolution of pop-culture and social communities.

So to sum up, the answer is “Yes” – the game is about Millennials. We hope that this clarifies things a bit and that the future updates will make more sense.


[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

That would be it for today, guys. We hope that you liked our little showcase, and you’re ready for more in the future. We’d also like to know if choosing the early 2000s as the setting makes you more or less interested in our game as a whole – it is set in stone, but we’re always interested in hearing your feedback. If something remains unclear, catch us in the comment section below, we’ll try to answer as fast as possible. 

If you want to keep up to date, remember to check our social media, join our discord sever and [b]wishlist us on Steam[/b] – you won’t miss any future update this way.

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png[/img][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Millennials/ 

Back to college we GO!

Frozen Way & Live Motion Games teams~

notes.title: Millennials are here - Back to college we go! It's time for a NEW life-sim game!
notes.content:
Listen up, Millennials! 

Believe it or not, this announcement has been a beast to type up! Especially with my mind consumed with enthusiasm as it is right now. 
To let you feel what I feel, join me for the very first development update! Grab your books and focus. It’s time to go back to college with our NEW TRAILER!

[previewyoutube=N4axI7RIKD0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N4axI7RIKD0[/previewyoutube]

I hope you’re ready for today's concept art devlog, which focuses on general information about the game. This showcase will shed light on everything you need to know. Are you ready, class? Let’s go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5f474c7b45dabf42f19948e30d68ca08b9514daf.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Millennials[/b][/h3]

What is this all about?

Millennials is a Life Simulator game with an isometric camera view set in college inspired by American pop culture of the 90s and 00s. Create your college freshman – but look out, their future career depends solely on you. Want to become one of the cool kids, a rising star of the academic world, or an unmatched athlete? It’s all up to your imagination. Throughout 4 years of education, you will have a lot of time to choose the right path. With the wide variety of possible activities, stories and relationships, you’ll have your hands full.

[h3][b]Campus[/b][/h3]

The campus is a large place divided into several areas. Try not to get lost, buddy! Let me lend you a hand. Today I’ll give you a map of the faculty of arts, but next time, I may not be around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/eeff6c5b2d1d44aa3e60cd05c8b09d645cb380bb.png[/img]

Improve your skills and stats by attending a bunch of different activities, such as classes in art, music, theater, and many more. Learning isn't everything! You'll be able to attend many club activities too. Below are examples of what the art class and the greenhouse looks like. Let us know which is your fav.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/9e6acb51c2c93362e7f5a16cac02f7faa34a6558.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/d20eb5e0e7f061f6bce8c6e5098a3c09f7610fd6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]The Dormitory[/b][/h3]

- Yaaaawn. 
- Oh, tired already? No problem! I’m here to show you around. Let me take you to the dormitory. That's the place where you can rest! 
Here all your problems will disappear. Play, party, sleep or read - spend your free time however you’d like. Socialize with other students, learn, and have fun! It’s up to you how you’ll spend your time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/9de0aefa51e8b32d3fa7d332c6a23f3c43c4764b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/b4cf2d5a2f11d750f17b121072abcfef852c5f8f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/33b9c2f00bef0f68883ecda152c843a73f63fa7d.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Teachers[/b][/h3]

To learn or not to learn? That is the question! Where would we be if the teachers didn’t keep a watchful eye on us? 
Their passion for teaching is almost as important as our will to learn. Let me introduce you to our three professors who’ll lead you through classes in Art, Mathematics and Sport. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/0b4b027e68db444c6ebc353d5abd0be452167407.png[/img]

[h3][b]Food[/b][/h3]

Last but not least, we have a sneak peek of what the food trucks will look like. We’re in the process of redesigning them, but the overall concept is the same. If you’re hungry, don't mind taking a bite of some tasty meal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ece67e9dd8047d4432582b6c5b5f4a06725c1cab.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Discord[/b][/h3]

However, before we end, it’s time for the news of a crucial matter! 
Millennials Official Discord Server is [b]NOW LIVE![/b]
Join the community and be a part of our game development phase! 
What’s left is to click the banner below and say hello, because you're all welcome!

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png[/img][/url]

[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

That would be it for today, Millennials. The dust of trailer launch day is finally settling down, so let’s finish this development update on a high note. I hope you liked our concept show. We’re curious about your opinion, so feel free to let us know in the comments. Please follow us on social media, and most importantly, add Millennials to your wishlist and follow for upcoming updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Millennials/
 

~Frozen Way & Live Motion Games Teams
